title: Contour-X Diamond Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: The Arai Contour-X Diamond Black is bridges highway aerodynamic poise with high-flow off-road ventilation, pairing peak visor aerodynamic stability with high-flow dust filtration. Featuring a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) architecture at 1474g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~91 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Designed for high-speed touring stability and comfort.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for oval head shapes; offers a roomier fit compared to the X-Spider series.

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai Contour-X Diamond Black: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Arai Contour-X Diamond Black: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai Contour-X Diamond Black. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

qualitative_intelligence.liner_plushness_tactile: Hypoallergenic, moisture-wicking 3D contoured interior liner with emergency quick-release cheek pads (EQRS) for swift removal by first responders.
qualitative_intelligence.visor_optical_clarity: Class 1 Distortion-Free Optically Correct shield with Pinlock 120 MaxVision anti-fog lens insert included.
real_world_pros: Exceptional aero-acoustic noise damping at high speeds
Lightweight shell construction reduces neck strain on long rides
Plush, fully removable and washable antimicrobial cheek liners
real_world_cons: Snug race-contour cheek pads require 2-3 rides for break-in
Premium price point reflecting top-tier safety certifications
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Arai Contour-X Diamond Black is a benchmark Commuter Full Face helmet, engineered to deliver uncompromised safety (ECE 22.06, DOT Certified) and all-day acoustic comfort for serious riders.

ergonomic_features.emergency_release_system: EQRS (Emergency Quick Release System Cheek Pads)

helmet_head_anatomy_matrix.action_camera_mounting_surface: Side shell contour supports Sena / Cardo clamp mounts & 3M helmet sticky pads easily

introduction: Positioned in Arai's Full Face lineup, the Contour-X Diamond Black brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Arai Contour-X Diamond Black represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~91 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai Contour-X Diamond Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
